name: NetBreaker2
description: Local Clash/mihomo TUN client: start and stop a virtual NIC, show kernel/TUN/elevation status, ping connectivity, and keep the last 10 log lines.

scripts.name: start
scripts.description: Start the Clash TUN connection (prompts for elevation when needed)

scripts.name: stop
scripts.description: Stop the Clash kernel and release the TUN device

scripts.name: ping
scripts.description: Probe the mixed inbound, controller, and a public TCP endpoint

scripts.name: ensure-kernel
scripts.description: Locate or download a user-local mihomo kernel into scripts/

scripts.name: clash
scripts.description: Locate the bundled Clash/mihomo kernel, or pass through arguments to it
